name: Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund
subject: Cop faces life in prison thanks to disgraced DA
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e8266470/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvTWMzcHNHS1dxSg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMDY/LbmNsQUJsRjRiVw/qP2hpZHM9bmNXR0tDb3BFSUc1NFdscw/gaasNTw/sekd97342c2)
|

| |
---
| |
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Fellow Patriot, Maybe you saw recently that a gunman opened fire outside a crowded bar in Austin, Texas, killing 3 innocent Americans. **Police officers responded in 57 seconds, running into the danger. They swiftly took down the gunman, saving countless lives.** Those officers should be commended for their heroic efforts in the face of danger and tragedy. But instead, the radical District Attorney in Austin nearly put those officers before a grand jury until public outrage made him back off. Why? Because the police shot the gunman. And DA Jose Garza – who has made a career out of bringing bogus charges against cops – requires all officer-involved shootings to go before a grand jury. [**If you agree that even considering murder charges against these heroes is beyond outrageous, I urgently need your help today.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) My name is Jason Johnson and I am the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). For over 30 years, LELDF has helped wrongly accused officers clear their names and get their lives back. We have a long record of success – getting charges dropped, winning at trial, and when all else fails, securing presidential pardons. **And right now we’re defending another Austin Police Officer who is fighting for his life.** _**Officer Chance Bretches is a decorated police officer. A loving husband. An amazing father.**_ He volunteers his time back in the community he swore an oath to protect. **Chance is everything woke leftists hate** – so, Garza has launched not one but TWO WITCH-HUNTS to put Chance behind bars for life:
---
1. In 2019, before Garza was in office, Chance was dispatched to arrest a known drug trafficker. The trafficker resisted arrest forcing Chance to use physical force to handcuff him. He was cleared by SIX different internal investigations. But upon taking office in 2021, Garza charged Chance with aggravated assault. He faces life in prison.
2. In May 2020 during the George Floyd riots, Chance was assigned to perform crowd control and issued a non-lethal beanbag launcher. When a rioter began throwing rocks at officers, Chance discharged his beanbag launcher. One of the beanbags injured another rioter’s hand – and Garza once again charged Chance with aggravated assault. He faces life in prison in this case, too.

---
Multiple investigations prove Chance followed his training and department protocols to a tee. **_But Garza won’t back down. He wants Chance to go to prison for the rest of his life._** **[That’s why I’m urgently turning to pro-police patriots like you to help Chance fight back.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** You see, Chance is scheduled to go on trial in the beanbag case in less than 90 days which makes your support today critical. This trial will cost approximately $150,000 – and that’s just the first trial. The date is still pending for the other. Meanwhile, LELDF currently supports more than a dozen other officers. [**Can I count on you to pitch in just $25, $50, or $100 to save this hero?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) I don’t have to tell you what happens to police officers in prison...they're targeted by violent criminals. **_This political witch-hunt against a good cop – an outstanding man – is a slap in the face to every American who respects the rule of law._** DA Garza showed us his true colors when he considered murder charges against the officer who stopped an active gunman from taking more lives in a crowded bar. **Now it’s time to stop him – and a send a message to all progressive prosecutors – before he ruins another good officer’s life.** Thank you for standing with Officer Chance Bretches and all the wrongly accused officers LELDF supports.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Jason C. Johnson President, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund
---
P.S. I wish I could say what’s happening to Officer Chance Bretches is unheard of – but the truth is that LELDF is supporting more than a dozen other wrongly accused officers right now. And we expect at least 10 of those cases to go to trial this year. **[So, please make your best possible gift to allow LELDF to support Chance and all the other officers relying on us. Thank you again for your support!](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ **STAND WITH CHANCE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | _More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_ [**Join our sustaining members by making a monthly gift to LELDF today!**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Dear Friend, If you listen to the political class long enough, you will eventually hear the same excuse: it's impossible to cut spending.They will say spending can only grow. They will say reform is impossible. They will say voters demand it.This week, the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** proved them wrong. Plus, we have updates from South Carolina, South Dakota, and elsewhere.

|

**WYOMING** The **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** , which controls the Wyoming State House, steered passage of a state budget that will reduce overall spending by roughly 1 percent compared to the previous budget.Was it the level of spending reduction the caucus wanted? No. But the reality of governing meant negotiating with a **hostile state Senate** while also facing a **Governor pushing for higher spending**.Even under those conditions, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus still delivered a budget that **shrinks government rather than growing it.** The fight isn't over though. The liberal Republican Governor could still line item veto some or all of the cuts. So the battle will continue next week.Rest assured, we have the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** firmly on our side to defend our shared conservative values of limited government and more freedom.

**SOUTH CAROLINA** South Carolina Republicans hold an overwhelming **88–36 supermajority** in the State House. With numbers like that, you would expect conservative reforms and strong judges on the bench.Instead, this week Republican leadership helped **elect two liberal Democrat judges**(the legislature in South Carolina selects judges, not the governor).The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** teamed up with members of the **South Carolina** **Family Caucus** to oppose the selections. But liberal Republicans joined with Democrats to push the judges through anyway.The timing made the decision even more troubling. During this same week, a liberal judge released **Justin Reyes** just one day after he allegedly stabbed a 58-year-old man who was walking his dog in Columbia, SC. This raises an obvious question. Why would Republicans with a supermajority vote to elevate liberal judges to the bench when those judges have a track record of siding with violent criminals instead of innocent victims? Because South Carolina isn't governed by a Republican supermajority.It's governed by a Uniparty of Democrats and liberal Republicans. What makes the situation even more frustrating is the political theater surrounding it. These same liberal Republicans are proudly voting for symbolic gestures such as recently naming a highway after President Trump!This gaslighting of voters is remarkably brazen.Symbolic politics distract the voters, while they install liberal Democrats on the bench. The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** can't win every fight, but they will educate the voters and expose this deceit. They have the grassroots on their side. They have conservative media on their side. And they have you on their side.

clean_body: | | | | Dear Friend, If you listen to the political class long enough, you will eventually hear the same excuse: it's impossible to cut spending.They will say spending can only grow. They will say reform is impossible. They will say voters demand it.This week, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus proved them wrong. Plus, we have updates from South Carolina, South Dakota, and elsewhere. | WYOMING The Wyoming Freedom Caucus , which controls the Wyoming State House, steered passage of a state budget that will reduce overall spending by roughly 1 percent compared to the previous budget.Was it the level of spending reduction the caucus wanted? No. But the reality of governing meant negotiating with a hostile state Senate while also facing a Governor pushing for higher spending.Even under those conditions, the Wyoming Freedom Caucus still delivered a budget that shrinks government rather than growing it. The fight isn't over though. The liberal Republican Governor could still line item veto some or all of the cuts. So the battle will continue next week.Rest assured, we have the Wyoming Freedom Caucus firmly on our side to defend our shared conservative values of limited government and more freedom. | SOUTH CAROLINA South Carolina Republicans hold an overwhelming 88–36 supermajority in the State House. With numbers like that, you would expect conservative reforms and strong judges on the bench.Instead, this week Republican leadership helped elect two liberal Democrat judges(the legislature in South Carolina selects judges, not the governor).The South Carolina Freedom Caucus teamed up with members of the South Carolina Family Caucus to oppose the selections. But liberal Republicans joined with Democrats to push the judges through anyway.The timing made the decision even more troubling. During this same week, a liberal judge released Justin Reyes just one day after he allegedly stabbed a 58-year-old man who was walking his dog in Columbia, SC. This raises an obvious question. Why would Republicans with a supermajority vote to elevate liberal judges to the bench when those judges have a track record of siding with violent criminals instead of innocent victims? Because South Carolina isn't governed by a Republican supermajority.It's governed by a Uniparty of Democrats and liberal Republicans. What makes the situation even more frustrating is the political theater surrounding it. These same liberal Republicans are proudly voting for symbolic gestures such as recently naming a highway after President Trump!This gaslighting of voters is remarkably brazen.Symbolic politics distract the voters, while they install liberal Democrats on the bench. The South Carolina Freedom Caucus can't win every fight, but they will educate the voters and expose this deceit. They have the grassroots on their side. They have conservative media on their side. And they have you on their side. | FREEDOM CAUCUS UNFILTERED - CLIP OF THE WEEK Each week we are highlighting a clip from our new radio show and podcast Freedom Caucus Unfiltered , where we bring you the Freedom Caucus perspective on national and state politics.This week’s clip features former Trump Chief of Staff and founding House Freedom Caucus member Mark Meadows. Meadows explains why “courage is contagious.” When lawmakers stand firmly on conservative principles, others are encouraged to step forward and support the fight.Make sure you subscribe so you never miss an episode. Subscribe on (or on your preferred podcast platform)Follow us on X \- us on TikTok \- us on Facebook \- | QUICK HITS ⚡️South Dakota : The legislature in South Dakota got a solid victory over the finish line this week. South Dakota Freedom Caucus Vice Chairman Sen. John Carley was the prime sponsor on a bill that would require only citizens to vote in state elections. The Senate passed it, 28-6, and then the House passed it, 64-3. It now heads to the governor for his signature! ⚡️Missouri: The Missouri House the REINS Act, 103–44, sponsored by Missouri Freedom Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Ben Keathley. The bill ensures that major regulations issued by state agencies must receive approval from elected lawmakers, keeping the administrative state in check.⚡️ Oklahoma: Oklahoma Freedom Caucus Chairman Sen. Shane Jett took to the Senate floor to challenge broadband subsidy programs that shift taxpayer money into favored industries. His : “This is not capitalism. This is effectively socialism.”⚡️ Media Meltdown: The Center for Media and Democracy calls itself a “nationally recognized watchdog.” In reality it is a left wing propaganda website. They recently published a hit piece on the Network titled “Extreme Right-Wing State Legislators Launch 2026 Agenda.” If you want a good laugh, . | HELP US KEEP BUILDING The victories you read about in this email do not happen by accident.They happen because disciplined Freedom Caucus members organize inside state legislatures, stand on conservative principles, and refuse to back down when the political class pushes back. Your support helps expand this model into more states, support our legislators, and expose what is really happening inside state capitols across the country. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresident State Freedom Caucus Network | |

Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. Did you hear the exciting news? **I'm officially on the ballot to become New Mexico's next governor!**

I felt so honored to deliver ballot petitions signed by thousands of grassroots supporters across New Mexico. And I felt proud to wear my traditional ribbon skirt as I filed. When I wear traditional clothing — like my ribbon skirt or my mocs — I'm reminded of how powerful our clothing is to our shared heritage. **I rock my ribbon skirt to honor the people whose shoulders I stand on.**

In a minute, I'm going to share some of the other places I've **rocked my ribbon skirt and mocs.** [ _**But before I do, I have to ask:**_**_Will you please help us build on this winning momentum by giving $5 to my campaign right now?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5906?refcode=jtk289-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7969%2E400544%2Ecqp6ml)

subject: We have a question for you:
body:
Who do you want to see at the top of the Democratic ticket in 2028?
#
We have a question for you.
_**Who do you want to see at the top of the Democratic ticket in 2028?**_
We’re running a brief survey to hear directly from people like you about the future of the Democratic Party and the direction of our country.
[**Will you take a minute or two to complete our 2028 presidential survey now and tell us which potential candidates you find most electable, and most ready to take on the GOP?**](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/2028-presidential-poll-and-lower-courts-survey/?source=em20260306-1522&t=1&akid=1522%2E2118727%2Eg7Qyi2)
Trump and the GOP have spent years tearing at our democracy, so the Democratic candidate in 2028 has to be ready with a plan to protect it and rebuild what has been damaged.
That’s why we’re also asking another important question about something that’s happening in our country right now:
Across the nation, lower court judges have been one of the few guardrails slowing down Trump’s most extreme abuses of power. They’ve blocked unlawful actions, placed injunctions when rights are at risk, and forced the administration to answer in court.
And now Republicans are openly trying to weaken those guardrails by limiting the power of lower courts to stop unlawful policies.
So in this survey, we want to know what you think: **Do you feel the lower courts are helping protect the rule of law?**
Your answer matters to us. We need a clear picture of what voters expect from future leaders and what it will take to win in 2028. **[So please, take our survey today.](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/2028-presidential-poll-and-lower-courts-survey/?source=em20260306-1522&t=2&akid=1522%2E2118727%2Eg7Qyi2)**
**[TAKE THE SURVEY ››](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/2028-presidential-poll-and-lower-courts-survey/?source=em20260306-1522&t=3&akid=1522%2E2118727%2Eg7Qyi2)**
Thank you for your input!
— LeftNet

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**

Trump and the GOP have spent years tearing at our democracy, so the Democratic candidate in 2028 has to be ready with a plan to protect it and rebuild what has been damaged. That’s why we’re also asking another important question about something that’s happening in our country right now: Across the nation, lower court judges have been one of the few guardrails slowing down Trump’s most extreme abuses of power. They’ve blocked unlawful actions, placed injunctions when rights are at risk, and forced the administration to answer in court. And now Republicans are openly trying to weaken those guardrails by limiting the power of lower courts to stop unlawful policies. So in this survey, we want to know what you think: Do you feel the lower courts are helping protect the rule of law? Your answer matters to us. We need a clear picture of what voters expect from future leaders and what it will take to win in 2028. Thank you for your input! — LeftNet LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.

Peter —
When we launched this campaign, we knew we would be taking on the billionaires and corporate mega-donors and their puppet politicians.
We knew the status quo would fight back. That’s exactly what we have seen — because the truth is, James has put Texas in play in a way that the corporate media and political establishment never thought possible.
That is not because of him. That is because of all of us, the people of this country.
Now that we are in the general election, the attacks and spending are going to increase exponentially.

There is an incredible amount of work ahead of us, and the path forward will not be easy. The only way we will raise what is required to win is from lots of people making small donations.

clean_body: | | | The 2026 Winter Paralympics opening ceremony will be held today, but Paralympic athletes are already competing in Milan. From skiing to curling, Paralympic athletes will be redefining what “limitations” are and inspiring a new generation of children with disabilities to continue to defy expectations. These athletes are going to Milan and will represent a country that often doesn’t represent them or their values. From cutting Medicaid funding to Trump openly using ableist slurs, this is a dangerous time to have disabilities in the United States. But these athletes show that no matter the limitations, we must continue to fight stereotypes and defy the odds. We don't just need inspiration; we need representation where the laws are made. ****Able Dems is proud to endorse Josh Turek for U.S. Congress. A two-time Paralympic gold medalist, Josh brought that same competitive grit to the Iowa Legislature, where he holds the reddest Democratic seat in the state. He has proven he can win in tough districts by focusing on the issues that matter to every family.**** Now, Josh is ready to take that fight to Washington. He isn't just running to fill a seat; he’s running to ensure the disabled community has a seat at the table. . It's not about principle any more.
It's nothing more than a tribal instinct: it's them versus us rather than working together for the country's best interests.

[ Abdul ]Abdul hunched over his desk, looking stressed

Kidding. But seriously, I’ve been on call time for hours.

It’s the not-so-glamorous part of campaigning where you literally sit in a
quiet room and call people to ask them to donate.

However, it’s a necessary part of our campaign, because I’m the only
candidate in this race who’s never taken corporate PAC or AIPAC money.

I don’t have a short list of billionaires I can call for a six-figure
check in exchange for a few favors once I’m in the Senate. And to be
honest, I wouldn’t want it any other way.

This campaign speaks clearly — and fights unapologetically — because of
who funds it: people like you,
Peter.

There’s no corporate-approved script I have to follow. We’re fighting for
what the people actually want:

* Medicare for All
* Abolishing ICE
* Ending corporate greed

But the only way a campaign like this can work is if everyone steps up.

people-powered campaign can compete.

Abdul

RGGI is a bipartisan, market-based program that helps states reduce carbon pollution while generating revenue to invest back into their communities. _For Virginia, that means resources to lower energy bills, improve energy efficiency, and make our grid more reliable._

**Energy affordability is a core part of my Affordable Virginia Agenda. And rejoining RGGI will help us protect jobs, strengthen our grid, and put money back into the pockets of Virginia families.**

We are expanding energy storage so we can capture cheaper power and use it during peak demand when prices are highest. That means savings for families and a more reliable grid for everyone.

We are also growing programs that help lower income Virginians make their homes more energy efficient. Simple improvements like better insulation and weatherization can save families hundreds - and even thousands of dollars per year.

And we are focused on making Virginia more energy independent with solar, nuclear, and offshore wind, including one of the largest infrastructure projects in Virginia history that will create thousands of jobs and generate billions of dollars in economic activity in coastal Virginia.

clean_body: RGGI is a bipartisan, market-based program that helps states reduce carbon pollution while generating revenue to invest back into their communities. | | Hi Peter, In my first address to the General Assembly, I proudly shared an important update about how we are lowering energy costs for Virginia families and strengthening our energy future: The Commonwealth of Virginia is rejoining the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative. RGGI is a bipartisan, market-based program that helps states reduce carbon pollution while generating revenue to invest back into their communities. For Virginia, that means resources to lower energy bills, improve energy efficiency, and make our grid more reliable. | Energy affordability is a core part of my Affordable Virginia Agenda. And rejoining RGGI will help us protect jobs, strengthen our grid, and put money back into the pockets of Virginia families. We are expanding energy storage so we can capture cheaper power and use it during peak demand when prices are highest. That means savings for families and a more reliable grid for everyone. We are also growing programs that help lower income Virginians make their homes more energy efficient. Simple improvements like better insulation and weatherization can save families hundreds - and even thousands of dollars per year. And we are focused on making Virginia more energy independent with solar, nuclear, and offshore wind, including one of the largest infrastructure projects in Virginia history that will create thousands of jobs and generate billions of dollars in economic activity in coastal Virginia. | Together, we can build an energy future that is affordable, reliable, and made in Virginia. Thank you for standing with me. Abigail Spanberger | | Paid for by United for Virginia's Future PAC United for Virginia's Future PAC P.O. Box 3121 Glen Allen, VA 23058 United States *

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Bernie Sanders and Ro Khanna just introduced a bill that would finally
force the billionaire class to pay up – and we need to show MASSIVE public
support for it right now. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36060?source=email-20230306&t=1011&akid=10333%2E5885482%2Etk606A ]Will you add your name to stand with Bernie?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36060?source=email-20230306&t=1012&akid=10333%2E5885482%2Etk606A ]Headline: Progressive lawmakers Bernie Sanders, Ro Khanna unveil $4.4T
wealth tax targeting billionaires

The bill would be a gamechanger. 938 people – the very richest Americans
like Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos – would pay a 5% tax on wealth above $1
billion, generating an estimated $4.4 TRILLION over the next decade for
our health care, housing, schools, and more.

As Trump pours our tax dollars into deadly wars and the pockets of his
cronies, it’s time to turn the tables. Bernie’s taking the fight directly
to the billionaire class, so now it’s our turn to have his back. With
enough grassroots momentum, together we can show Congress that the public
has had enough.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36060?source=email-20230306&t=1013&akid=10333%2E5885482%2Etk606A ]Let’s give the billionaires a reason to be scared. Add your name: Tell
Congress to support Bernie’s Billionaire Wealth Tax NOW!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36060?source=email-20230306&t=1014&akid=10333%2E5885482%2Etk606A ]ADD YOUR NAME

If the bill became law, every person in a household earning less than
$150,000 a year would get a one-time $3,000 payment (that’s $12,000 for a
family of four!). But it doesn’t stop there: The revenue would expand
Medicare and Medicaid to cover more people, build hundreds of thousands of
affordable homes, cap child care costs, and make sure every public school
teacher is paid at least $60,000 a year.

The Make Billionaires Pay Their Fair Share Act already sent the
billionaire elite into a panic. Jeff Bezos’s Washington Post just
published an angry op-ed attacking the proposal, defending the
ultra-wealthy as they cling to their oversized fortunes while everyday
Americans struggle.

Enough is enough. Bernie’s bill would FINALLY close the loopholes the rich
have written for themselves. And now we can use this moment to show
Congress that the public won’t rest until the billionaires are forced to
pay their fair share.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36060?source=email-20230306&t=1015&akid=10333%2E5885482%2Etk606A ]Let’s send a message that can’t be ignored: the American people stand
with Bernie and demand billionaires pay their fair share. Add your name to
support the wealth tax – together we can show Congress this is a movement,
not a moment.

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

Peter, **Two days ago, Becca walked into a congressional hearing and confronted Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem directly.** She asked the questions many people in power were avoiding. She demanded accountability for DHS ignoring court orders. She told Noem plainly that the American people would not forget the lawlessness happening on her watch. **And yesterday? Donald Trump fired her as Secretary.** Now, let’s be clear: Kristi Noem wasn’t removed because the administration suddenly discovered a conscience. Reports say her removal came after weeks of mounting controversy and intense scrutiny from lawmakers following contentious congressional hearings. **But here’s what matters: the pressure worked.** When leaders speak up. When people pay attention. When elected officials refuse to let abuses of power happen quietly behind closed doors. Things change. [_**If you want more moments like this — moments where people in power are forced to answer for what they’ve done — please chip in today to help Becca keep fighting for accountability in Congress.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126804153/606003708/237042328?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNjk5NDUyMC04ZTE5LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P2di7_Q7r8kZ2-sOYHyHXI5Ew1-EmwoTQsr1OYZ1ZYM=) Too often, the people responsible for harming families, breaking laws, or abusing their power expect Congress to move on. They expect the outrage to fade. They expect nobody to KEEP asking questions. **But we all know that’s not how Becca works.** When DHS officials ignored court orders, she said so. When testimony didn’t match what judges had already ruled, she called it out. When Noem tried to dodge responsibility, she told her directly: the American people deserve accountability. **And she meant it.** **[HELP KEEP THE PRESSURE ON!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126804154/606003709/237042328?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNjk5NDUyMC04ZTE5LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P2di7_Q7r8kZ2-sOYHyHXI5Ew1-EmwoTQsr1OYZ1ZYM=)** This moment is a reminder of something powerful: **when people organize, pay attention, and demand answers, the political ground shifts**. name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: Charlie’s final book wasn’t about politics...
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih2tmrz3z1hbj5lqi5b4t0peptwox6qb3111jhsr6kp1ey9155q70snrme4jqg31i0kdfibx8vhvqm75ozfpdc6znklvt1&__stmp=tbhret&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)
---
**[Support Turning Point USA](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)**
---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. Thank you, and God bless!](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbhret&__onlt=h)**

Team:The Supreme Court didn't rule on Louisiana v. Callais , but a decision from the so-called "shadow docket" holds some ominous warning signs for that case and the future of the Voting Rights Act (VRA).
The Supreme Court this week reversed a lower court order requiring the drawing of a "minority opportunity district" in New York state. The lower court had ruled that that type of district was likely required under the New York state Constitution.
" What's that kind of district ," you ask? Minority opportunity districts are electoral districts drawn during redistricting to ensure minority populations can elect candidates of their choice , often functioning as "majority-minority" districts. These districts help minorities overcome historical underrepresentation and are mandated by the Voting Rights Act to prevent the use of gerrymandering to dilute minority voting power.
Well, the opponents of voting rights on the Supreme Court didn't care about that. Conservative Justice Samuel Alito, writing for the majority in the sudden decision, said that that race conscious districting in state laws and state constitutions is “ unadorned ” and “ odious ” racial discrimination. Against white people, we assume he means.
This is most ominous for Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.

“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
Ari Berman at Mother Jones said it best after oral arguments: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding, with the VRA no longer able to stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.

# [For decades, the global system worked in America's favor](https://substack.com/redirect/ee4ef2c8-7d63-4130-8387-b8d2f5f5a4f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---|---|---
* The dollar anchored trade.
* U.S. debt was absorbed.
* Markets relied on stability.

That stability is now being tested.
When America First policies reshaped trade and alliances, global financial dynamics shifted.
**Now even the[2026 Munich Security Report](https://substack.com/redirect/0abb6cb9-94be-4e5e-aae9-68cb179c6503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) describes the post-war order as being "under destruction."**
That's institutional language.
* **Foreign governments are reducing reliance on the U.S. dollar.**
* **Central banks are increasing gold reserves.**
* **U.S. debt has surpassed $38 trillion.**

These are measurable shifts -- not political talking points.
Most IRAs and 401(k)s remain heavily concentrated in stock-heavy, dollar-based assets that depend on global confidence.
If that confidence weakens, valuations adjust.
**[See what this could mean for your retirement portfolio here.](https://substack.com/redirect/0abb6cb9-94be-4e5e-aae9-68cb179c6503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Inside the newly released report, you'll learn:
* Why reserve diversification is accelerating
* How rising debt increases retirement vulnerability
* What structural instability could mean for IRAs and 401(k)s
* How some Americans are adding gold and silver to retirement accounts**(tax and penalty free)**

* **Credit quality concerns:** Recent moves spark worries about broader distress in private lending.

### [BlackRock limits withdrawals on 26 billion dollar fund](https://substack.com/redirect/e732eb10-73ed-4835-a0b9-e909733aa6dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
BlackRock has **[restricted withdrawals from its $26 billion private credit fund](https://substack.com/redirect/e732eb10-73ed-4835-a0b9-e909733aa6dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as investor redemption requests surged amid growing concerns about liquidity and risk in the rapidly expanding $1.8 trillion private credit sector.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d051f898-ec94-47ab-be0e-8c9a3acabcfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive fund hit:** BlackRock's flagship private credit vehicle now limiting outflows.
* **Redemption pressure:** Sharp rise in withdrawal demands from nervous investors.
* **Liquidity concerns:** Latest sign of stress in the opaque private credit market.

* **Gulf Scorpion strike:** Recent attacks highlight vulnerability of high-value air defense systems.
* **Swarm tactics:** Iran deploying large numbers of cheap drones to overwhelm defenses.
* **Strategic headache:** US and allies forced to rethink air defense economics.

* **Efficiency focus:** Company aims to improve margins amid shifting priorities.

body:
We have to teach ourselves the skills necessary to build a new world.
#
When I first decided to run for office, there were only 2-3 lawyers in all of New York City that knew how to draft a petition to get onto an election ballot.
If you wanted to run for office, you couldn't unless one of those three people — in a city of 8 million — said they would do this for you.
**That, of course, is antidemocratic**. Because those three people then control the entire candidate pipeline of who can run for office in all of New York City, at any level.
So we went out and we hit the books, and we found elders in eastern Queens who finally said, "We will show you how to do this." And not only did they show me how to put together a petition, but they showed me how to properly collect a signature — because if you don't do it properly, you will get kicked off the ballot — and how to collect more signatures than the requirement, which was around 2,000 in 2018.
We set a goal of 10,000 signatures, so that there was _no way_ that they could throw us off of the ballot. And in that process, **we built the foundation that led us to winning that election**.
In a lot of different places and races, there are people who could easily pay a firm to collect these signatures. And to this day, people say, "Why do you still run your petitioning process on all-volunteer basis? It's way harder."
**Because this democratic knowledge needs to stay in our communities.
This skill set needs to live with the people.
And it should never be gatekept or bottlenecked ever again.**
In a moment like this, when there's so much despair in the air, so much not knowing what's going on, the response is that _all of us have to skill up, in every way_.
Electorally. Non-electorally. We have to teach ourselves the skills necessary to build a new world.
Oftentimes, "revolution" sounds really big and splashy. But there's a lot of meetings, bureaucracy, and phone calls involved in radical changes of the world.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260306.gxTpQ1&refcode=em20260306-10913-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10913%2E2526796%2E17AC1R)
Petitioning is tedious, bureaucratic work. But when we go out into the community to get signatures to reelect me to Congress, we are doing the work of invitation: **Join our movement for a better world**.
Because this country is still a place of possibility. **And together, we will win**.
[Will you help sustain our fight by making a grassroots contribution today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260306.gxTpQ1&refcode=em20260306-10913-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10913%2E2526796%2E17AC1R)
Every donation helps us mobilize, organize, and fight for the working class in the places that need it most.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: The fight for Texas’ future
body:
This lesson has guided me my whole life.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
March 6 is a date every Texan learns about in school: **the Battle of the Alamo.**
The Alamo was a pivotal moment in our history — and it reminds us of who we are. It illustrates the courage, sacrifice, and hope for the future that define our state.
Texans aren’t afraid of a fight, no matter how long the odds. And we know that we may not win every battle, but that won’t stop us from standing up for our families, our communities, our state, and our future. To me, that is simply the spirit of Texas.
I grew up in the Rio Grande Valley, where independence wasn’t just something you read about in a history book — it was something you lived every single day.
And my grandmother had a simple way of putting it whenever life got hard:
**_“No te dejes.”_**
Fight back. Stand your ground. Don’t let anyone push you around.
That lesson has guided me my whole life.
It’s why I ran for school board when powerful interests tried to shut down my son’s public school. It’s why I ran for the Texas House to fight for our neighborhood schools, our families, and our communities. And it’s why I’m running for governor.
**Because the fight for Texas isn’t something that only happened in the past.**
Today, families across our state are fighting for good schools, affordable health care, and the chance to build a life where hard work actually pays off. They’re fighting for the freedom to make their own decisions and for a government that answers to the people of Texas — not wealthy donors and corporate interests.
That fight is part of who we are. Texans have never been afraid to stand up for our future. We’ve never waited for someone else to come along and fix things for us.
We fight. We organize. We build something better together, in the spirit of Texas.
This campaign is about keeping that spirit alive. That’s why I’m asking, Peter:
**[Will you make a $5 donation now to join us in the fight for Texas’ future?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260306_1_alamo.pHf-yw&refcode=em20260306-716&amount=5&t=1&akid=716%2E299639%2EY5nRN1)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260306_1_alamo.pHf-yw&amount=5&refcode=em20260306-716&t=20&akid=716%2E299639%2EY5nRN1)
Thank you for being in this fight with me,
Gina Hinojosa

That won’t stop.

As this campaign moves forward, I’ll keep sharing updates about where we’re going, who we’re meeting, what I’m hearing from Rhode Islanders, and how we’re building this together.

You’ll hear about the wins. You’ll hear about the challenges. And you’ll hear about what comes next.

subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/6/2026
body:
Nine-year sentence questioned: Peters’ attorneys cite contrast with Lewis case
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are advancing limits on [utilities’ use of eminent domain](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after backlash over Xcel Energy’s Power Pathway project. Commentary also raises [questions about Gary Community Ventures’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) influence on Colorado policy debates, while critics say lawmakers are sending [mixed signals on parental rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Another analysis warns that [decades of diverting road taxes under the state’s “Noble Bill”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) have contributed to Colorado’s transportation funding problems.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A complaint alleges nearly [487,000 voter records changed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after elections were certified, raising new transparency questions. Meanwhile, Gov. Jared Polis considers [clemency for Tina Peters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) following contrast with the Lewis case. Denver Public Schools is considering a [“safe zone” policy limiting ICE access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) without a warrant, while the city is [withholding a completed $110,000 investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) into a police division chief. A Democrat-backed redistricting proposal could [flip three GOP congressional seats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and the wildlife commission is [advancing a possible fur sales ban](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The U.S.–Israeli strike on Iran is [reshaping global politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [disrupting China’s Middle East strategy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Rising tensions are also affecting energy markets as insurers pull war-risk coverage for ships in the Strait of Hormuz, [potentially pushing fuel prices higher](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, Congress is [probing Colorado’s Medicaid program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over fraud concerns, new polling shows [strong Republican approval for President Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) early in his second term, and Oklahoma Sen. Markwayne Mullin has been [tapped to lead Homeland Security](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, March 6, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Nine-year sentence questioned: Peters’ attorneys cite contrast with Lewis case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Tina Peters’ attorneys said Wednesday they appreciate Gov. Jared Polis taking a look at her clemency request, pointing to what they believe is a sentencing disparity.
Peters’ attorneys shared the statement with RMV after Polis posted about the [case of former state Sen. Sonya Jaquez Lewis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) while talking about clemency.
They said that [contrast between Lewis’ and Peters’ case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is central to their clemency request. “Tina Peters is grateful to Governor Polis for considering her request for clemency,” the statement said.
The defense team also echoed a comment Polis made in a recent social media post about fairness in the justice system. “As the governor said, Justice in Colorado and America needs to be applied evenly, you never know when you might need to depend on the rule of law,” the statement said.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Why did nearly 500,000 Colorado voter records change after elections were certified?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **HAVA complaint raises election transparency concerns:** A formal complaint under the federal Help America Vote Act alleges 487,887 voter participation records were modified after Colorado elections were certified, raising questions about database integrity and oversight.
* **Changes span multiple election cycles:** The filing cites 328,895 record changes tied to the 2020 election, 155,576 tied to 2022, and 3,416 tied to 2024, with voter histories shifting between “vote” and “no vote” or reflecting ballots added or removed after certification.
* **Critics say voters deserve transparency:** While the complaint does not allege election fraud, it argues federal law requires accurate, stable voter records and calls for hearings and document production to explain how post-certification changes occurred.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Insurance Turmoil in the Strait of Hormuz Could Ripple Into U.S. Energy Prices](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **War-risk insurance pulls back in Persian Gulf:** Marine insurers are canceling or sharply increasing war-risk coverage for ships operating near Iran, forcing some vessels to delay voyages through the critical Strait of Hormuz.
* **Shipping slowdown threatens global oil flow:** Tankers have begun pausing near the strait as insurers reassess risks, tightening one of the world’s most important energy corridors and driving up the cost of moving oil.
* **Higher costs likely to reach American consumers:** When insurance costs spike and shipping slows, oil prices typically rise—eventually showing up as higher gasoline, transportation, and everyday consumer prices in the U.S.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Same Colorado law, different outcomes: Probation in Denver, prison in Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 4** _In Colorado, the same felony statute led to two very different courtroom outcomes. One walked away with probation. Peters is now serving a prison sentence that stretches close to a decade. The case against Peters unfolded under Colorado’s statute on attempting to influence a public servant—§ 18-8-306, the same law used in the prosecution of former Colorado state Sen. Sonya Jaquez Lewis._
**[Why Iran Matters to Every Single American](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | MARCH 4** _There are Americans right now screaming, “Why are we in Iran? This isn’t our fight.” Let’s slow that down. What’s unfolding in the Middle East isn’t a foreign skirmish on a map most people can’t read. It’s a defining moment for American security, American prosperity, and American credibility — and it affects every one of us, whether we’re paying attention or not._ __
**[From ethics complaint to felony conviction: How forged letters ended a Colorado lawmaker’s career](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 4** _The investigation that ended former Colorado Sen. Sonya Jaquez Lewis’ political career did not begin with police or prosecutors. It began inside her own office. It ended in a Denver courtroom. There, jurors found the former lawmaker guilty on four felony counts tied to letters submitted during a legislative ethics investigation._ __

Developed by a committee led by Princeton psychologist Carl Brigham, it was designed to measure innate ability rather than learned knowledge. The 90-minute, 315-question test included nine sections like artificial language and analogies.

Hey folks,
I went live today with my friend **Joe Walsh** , and we talked about the surgery, the recovery, and that weird mental space you end up in when your body is healing but the world keeps spinning. Then we got into the politics -- Trump firing Kristi Noem, the collapsing jobs numbers, and the dangerous mess unfolding with Iran. It's personal. It's political. And honestly, it's the kind of conversation I think a lot of us needed this week.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* **00:01:07** -- I give Joe the real update on the surgery recovery: what the good days feel like, what the bad days feel like, and the strange psychological toll that comes with healing.
* **00:06:24** -- We break down Trump abruptly firing Kristi Noem and why it's less a show of strength and more a sign of political panic.
* **00:09:52** -- The economy conversation gets serious: lost jobs, stagnant wages, tariffs, and why Trump may have inherited a strong economy only to derail it.
* **00:18:20** -- Joe and I dig into the war with Iran -- why it's unconstitutional, politically risky, and dangerously unclear in its goals.
* **00:27:33** -- A blunt debate about whether Democrats should fund the war at all -- and why this could become a defining political mistake.

Joe and I don't always agree on everything, but that's exactly why these discussions matter. If you value honest conversations about politics, accountability, and where this country is headed, help me keep them going.

subject: On to the runoffs!
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
FINISHING STRONG:
Showing the strength of our communities this primary election
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Menefee%20with%20TOP%20PAC%20canvassers.jpg]
That's a wrap! Amid record-shattering voting across the state, TOP PAC's get-out-the-vote team made its presence felt, engaging with and mobilizing 109,000 Texas voters to cast their ballot for a slate of progressive endorsed champions. This is people power and political power in action!
TOP was built on the belief that our Black and Latino communities too often ignored by those in power deserve a voice, not simply a seat at the table. For over 15 years now, we’ve brought thousands of Texans into the movement, endorsing leaders and driving policies that seek to improve everyday lives -– unapologetic proven leaders like Jasmine Crockett and Gina Hinojosa who have shown their commitment to defending our communities.
And while not every electoral race went the way we had hoped this primary, our voter outreach helped 12 out of our 15 endorsed candidates secure victories or runoffs.
Texas’ future will be shaped by conversations that matter — the ones we’re having in neighborhoods through organizing and our get-out-the-vote work. Now more than ever, as far-right efforts grow to spread misinformation, stoke fear, and restrict access to voting (like what we saw in Dallas County on Election Day) our work is essential. Meanwhile, we’ll continue engaging our Black and Latino communities around a bold vision of shared safety and prosperity that puts our communities first.
Let's get to work, and see you in the runoffs!
TAKE OUR SURVEY:
Weigh in on how healthcare impacts YOU!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Make%20your%20voice%20heard.png]
The attacks to healthcare access and affordability in Trump 2.0 have been no joke. From higher health insurance premium costs, to massive cuts to Medicaid, Texans of all walks of life are feeling the negative impacts.
Healthcare is a human right at TOP , and at this critical time with our healthcare system looking bleak, we want to hear from YOU – members, supporters, and community allies.
Weigh in on what REAL healthcare looks like to you, and share your personal story.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eng.%20-%20Take%20survey.png]
GIVE US A BOOST:
Help TOP host a panel at this year's Netroots Nation conference
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP applied to host a panel at Netroots Nation this year, and we'd love your VOTE to make this panel a reality. It'll take you less than a minute to show your support, and it'll get us closer to sharing TOP's theory of change on the national stage with hundreds of progressive activists and organizers from across the country.
Just follow these quick steps:
1. Check out our panel topic, "Texas: MAGA before MAGA and how we can still win!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Click on the blue "Vote for this submission" button.
3. Create a new account if you need to, or log in to your existing Netroots account.
4. Select our panel and vote!
Feel free to share the panel link on your social media, and use the hashtag #NN26 .
TRUMP TRACKER:
The FIFA Peace Prize winner sure likes war
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/War%20Iran.jpg]
Welcome to another edition of our Trump Tracker, where we apply Critical Ignoring [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] to help fight the right-wing's "flood the zone" [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] approach that seeks to divide and demoralize us.
No matter how the White House tries to spin it, the truth is that Donald Trump is entrenching the U.S. in another completely unnecessary war (this horrendous administration can't justify it), all to distract from his sinking poll numbers, scandals, and domestic policy failures. [http://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/feb/28/diversionary-war-trump-wants-to-distract-americans-from-scandals-at-home] And Republicans on Capitol Hill are too cowardly to stop him.
On top of the violence being inflicted on civilians, this foreign policy aggression from our self-declared "Peace President" has already cost U.S. taxpayers more than $5 billion in only a few days of operations — funds that could cover SNAP benefits for more than 2 million people in the U.S.! [https://www.americanprogress.org/article/the-trump-administrations-reckless-war-in-iran-has-already-cost-more-than-5-billion/]
To make matters worse, POTUS and his MAGA loyalists couldn't care less about the estimated hundreds of thousands of lives they are displacing through this military escalation. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/andyjsemotiuk/2026/03/05/how-the-iran-conflict-may--fuel-a-new-international-refugee-crisis/]
So what's the foreign policy of Trump 2.0? Staight-up imperialism. [https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/political-commentary/trump-america-military-industrial-iran-war-1235524970/]
Español
TERMINANDO CON UNA NOTA ALTA:
Mostrando la fuerza de nuestras comunidades en estas elecciones primarias
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Menefee%20with%20TOP%20PAC%20canvassers.jpg]
¡Eso es todo! En medio de una votación récord en todo el estado, el equipo de TOP PAC para impulsar el voto se hizo sentir, conectando y movilizando a 109,000 votantes texanos para que emitieran su voto por una lista de líderes progresistas respaldados. ¡Esto es poder popular y poder político en acción!
TOP se fundó con la convicción de que nuestras comunidades negras y latinas, a menudo ignoradas por quienes ostentan el poder, merecen una voz, no solo un lugar en la mesa. Durante más de 15 años, hemos sumado a miles de tejanos al movimiento, respaldando a líderes e impulsando políticas que buscan mejorar la vida cotidiana: líderes probadas y sin complejos como Jasmine Crockett y Gina Hinojosa , quienes han demostrado su compromiso con la defensa de nuestras comunidades.
Y aunque no todas las contiendas electorales resultaron como esperábamos en estas primarias, nuestra labor de acercamiento a los votantes ayudó a 12 de nuestros 15 candidatos respaldados a conseguir victorias o llegar a la segunda vuelta.
El futuro de Texas se forjará con conversaciones importantes: las que mantenemos en los vecindarios mediante la organización y nuestro trabajo para promover el voto. Ahora más que nunca, ante el aumento de los esfuerzos de la extrema derecha por difundir desinformación, sembrar el miedo y restringir el acceso al voto (como lo que vimos en el condado de Dallas el día de las elecciones), nuestro trabajo es esencial. Mientras tanto, seguiremos involucrando a nuestras comunidades negras y latinas en torno a una visión audaz de seguridad y prosperidad compartidas que priorice a nuestras comunidades.
¡Manos a la obra! ¡Nos vemos en la segunda vuelta!
RESPONDA NUESTRA ENCUESTA:
Opine sobre cómo la atención médica le impacta
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Levanta%20Tu%20Voz.png]
Los ataques al acceso y la asequibilidad de la atención médica bajo la administración Trump 2.0 no han sido ninguna broma. Desde el aumento de las primas de los seguros médicos hasta los recortes masivos a Medicaid, los tejanos de todos los ámbitos están sintiendo los impactos negativos.
La atención médica es un derecho humano en TOP , y en este momento crítico con nuestro sistema de salud en declive, queremos saber de USTEDES: miembros, simpatizantes y aliados de la comunidad.
Opine sobre cómo ve la atención médica REAL y comparta su historia personal.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Span.%20-%20Take%20survey.png]
VOTA POR NOSOTROS:
Ayuda a TOP a organizar un panel en la conferencia Netroots Nation de este año
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP solicitó organizar un panel en Netroots Nation este año, y nos encantaría contar con su VOTO para hacerlo realidad. Le tomará menos de un minuto mostrar su apoyo , y nos ayudará a acercarnos a compartir la teoría de cambio de TOP en el escenario nacional con cientos de activistas y organizadores progresistas de todo el país.
Solo sigue estos pasos:
1. Consulta el tema de nuestro panel: "Texas: ¡MAGA antes de MAGA y cómo aún podemos ganar!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Haz clic en el botón azul "Vota por esta propuesta."
3. Crea una cuenta nueva si lo necesitas o inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Netroots.
4. ¡Selecciona nuestro panel y vota!
Comparte el enlace del panel en tus redes sociales y usa la etiqueta #NN26 .
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP:
El ganador del Premio de la Paz de la FIFA realmente disfruta de la guerra
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/War%20Iran.jpg]
Bienvenidos a otra edición de nuestro Rastreador de Trump , donde aplicamos la Ignorancia Crítica [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] para ayudar a combatir el enfoque de la derecha de "inundar la zona" [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] que busca dividirnos y desmoralizarnos.
No importa cómo la Casa Blanca intente presentarlo, la verdad es que Donald Trump está atrincherando a Estados Unidos en otra guerra completamente innecesaria (esta horrenda administración no puede justificarla), todo para distraer la atención de sus desplomes en las encuestas, escándalos y fracasos en la política interna. [https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2026/feb/28/diversionary-war-trump-wants-to-distract-americans-from-scandals-at-home] Y los republicanos en el Capitolio son demasiado cobardes para detenerlo.
Además de la violencia que se inflige a la población civil, esta agresión en política exterior por parte de nuestro autoproclamado "Presidente de la Paz" ya ha costado a los contribuyentes estadounidenses más de 5 mil millones de dólares en tan solo unos días de operaciones: ¡fondos que podrían cubrir las prestaciones del SNAP para más de 2 millones de personas en Estados Unidos! [https://www.americanprogress.org/article/the-trump-administrations-reckless-war-in-iran-has-already-cost-more-than-5-billion/]
Para empeorar las cosas, al presidente de Estados Unidos y a sus partidarios de MAGA les importan un bledo los cientos de miles de vidas que se estima que están desplazando con esta escalada militar.
Entonces, ¿cuál es la política exterior de Trump 2.0? Imperialismo. [https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/political-commentary/trump-america-military-industrial-iran-war-1235524970/]
